title: Lista de estudiantes del curso
brief: Course view with the student grade list, with color for grade states (passing, failing, pending, locked, empty). Dark theme by default with a light toggle; uses the NOTAZOD tokens.

artboards.title: Planilla con color
artboards.tradeoff: Closest to today's table, low migration cost; adds summary cards and tinted grade chips. Still dense, risk is read cell by cell.

artboards.title: Semáforo por estudiante
artboards.tradeoff: Each student is a row with a status stripe, progress bar against 3,0 and filters; at-risk first. Very scannable, but shows fewer students per screen and is weaker for fast grade entry.

artboards.title: Panel lateral y mapa de calor
artboards.tradeoff: Sidebar with courses and filters (including 'Sin subir al Campus'), corte tabs and heat-map cells. Best for triage and ties into Verificar Campus; biggest layout change.
